analytical_takeaway: Local Differential Privacy protects each user's raw feature values before transmission to the central server, eliminating the single point of failure of a trusted aggregator. However, because noise is added to every record independently, the variance scales as O(1/epsilon) per record, leading to observable degradation in downstream F1-score when noise is severe.
